{{Top}}
[[File:Diplomat_TotG.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] diplomat]]
{{Quote|I'm a member of the Imperial Senate on a diplomatic mission to Alderaan.|Princess Leia Organa|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
A '''diplomat''' was someone involved in diplomacy, the art and practice of conducting negotiations between representatives of groups or states. They were studious followers of politics and law. Some were devoted to free democracy. Others, like the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Senator/Legends|senators]], were more interested in their own needs. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia's]] parents were noted [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] diplomats.

{{Stub}}

==Diplomats==
{{Quote|Making peace is still more important than making war. Any sentient with a club can make war. Your training as a diplomat we will start.|Yoda to Ahsoka Tano|<ref name="wrot">''[[The Clone Wars: The Wind Raiders of Taloraan]]''</ref>}}
The key role of any given diplomat was to simply keep up relations with other species, planets, and systems. Since there was an amazingly vast amount of species in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], their role was a vital one.

Each sector had at least one [[Senator/Legends|Senator]], a form of diplomat that partook in meetings with the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. In some cases, there may have been two or more senators from any given planet, such as with [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] from [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].
